content:
Marco Silva: flagging Azure marketplace invoice AMZ-7781 — dashboard shows total amount but the manifest JSON is empty when our ingest runs. need help triaging.
billing-bot: webhook event: manifest_blob=azure://partner-manifests/AMZ-7781.json size=0 bytes, etag=\"0x8DXYZ\"
Priya Nair: confirmed via storage logs: object exists but Content-Length=0. our parser fails with schema error.
Eve (Reseller Ops): reseller was charged $9,842.50 on 2026-04-15. without line items we can't allocate to sub-accounts. customers are pinging for breakdown.
Marco Silva: partner contact is chris@marketpartner.io — cc'ing partner ops. can we issue a temporary memo or hold collections until resolved?
Finance-approvals-bot: policy check: provisional credits require manual approval for amounts >$2,500. Escalation to FinOps required.
Priya Nair: tagging FinOps — if partner re-uploads before EOD we can avoid issuing any adjustments. request them to provide original storage SAS URL and server-side upload ID.
partnerops-bot: sent message to partner contact at 2026-04-16T09:12Z: "Please re-upload manifest and provide storage object id and md5."
Chris (Partner): we reuploaded, but looks like our pipeline accidentally wrote a zero-byte placeholder. new file: azure://partner-manifests/AMZ-7781-v2.json size=24,768 bytes md5=7b8f...
billing-bot: new blob detected: azure://partner-manifests/AMZ-7781-v2.json size=24768 bytes checksum OK
Priya Nair: downloaded v2 and validated schema. sample lines: 
```
{"reseller_id":"res-987","account_id":"acct-44","usage_units":12000,"amount":1842.50}
{"reseller_id":"res-123","account_id":"acct-77","usage_units":56000,"amount":8000.00}
```
Totals reconcile to $9,842.50.
Eve (Reseller Ops): great — I'll send allocations to affected resellers and include the manifest in the dispute packet.
Marco Silva: logging action in ticket #5031 and marking billing hold cleared.
Finance-approvals-bot: provisional hold removed. No credit memo required.
Priya Nair: running ledger update: `INSERT INTO invoice_line_items (invoice_id,reseller_id,account_id,usage,amount) VALUES ('AMZ-7781','res-987','acct-44',12000,1842.50),('AMZ-7781','res-123','acct-77',56000,8000.00);` then `UPDATE invoices SET status='reconciled' WHERE invoice_id='AMZ-7781';`
Eve (Reseller Ops): I'll notify CS teams and close out follow-ups. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
